title: SSR emits ordinary text and some attributes without HTML escaping
note: Static verification in both serializers. Use context-aware escaping in one serializer and provide an explicit trusted HTML path. Fixed in both output paths. Regression coverage verifies parsed text and attributes, the trusted HTML path, and raw-text handling.

title: SSR storage reuses values across requests
note: Separate public SSR renders observed the same persisted fixture values. Scope fallback stores to the request or require explicit injection. Fixed by allocating a private fallback per prop. Headless requests start from their own defaults and browser Storage still persists.

title: Documented key and token helpers use Math.random
note: Use a platform CSPRNG for security-oriented helpers and document minimum token entropy. Fixed by using Web Crypto for bytes, hex, and UUIDs, with explicit failure when the platform lacks secure randomness.

title: SSG writes lack output-directory containment
note: Conditional on untrusted route input. Canonicalize routes and confine all destinations, including through links, before writing. Validate canonical route paths before rendering, preflight every destination, and reject symlinks throughout the resolved output tree.

title: Vite lock includes an affected network-exposed development server
note: The Vite advisory GHSA-p4f5-76q4-ffq7 lists 7.3.2 as affected when dev servers are explicitly exposed. Upgrade to a maintained patched release, at least 7.3.8 on 7.x. Exposure unverified. Upgraded every workspace Vite resolution to 7.3.8 and restricted the plugin peer range to maintained patched Vite 6 and 7 releases. Workspace pnpm check passed.

title: Broadcast sync crosses backing-store boundaries
note: Same-key local storage updates overwrote session state. Include store and partition identity in message routing. Scoped localStorage and explicitly named custom channels separately. Session storage remains inside its browser session.

title: Broadcast sync replays stale snapshots into durable storage
note: Overlapping peer updates can diverge and overwrite storage. Use invalidation from authoritative storage or ordered versioned reconciliation. Broadcasts now notify peers to re-read authoritative storage. Applying a remote update never writes a stale snapshot back.

title: Clearing a keyed list removes preceding siblings
note: Runtime clear removed an unrelated heading. Give every list an owned start and end range. Bulk clearing now uses the first and last owned entry boundaries and preserves sibling nodes.

title: Full keyed replacement carries state into a different record
note: Runtime verification observed one mount and old editable state under the new key. Preserve entry identity only for surviving keys. Rows whose keys disappear are disposed. Fully replacing a list bulk-clears old entries and creates fresh scopes for new keys.

title: List template reuse guesses the shape of later rows
note: Reproduced in Repeat and KeyedForEach. Reuse only structurally proven templates or declare a stable template contract. Check template compatibility for every row, preserve keyed range markers, and keep extracted slots in builder order. Added DOM regressions.

title: Removing a listener during dispatch skips another subscriber
note: A once-listener caused the next ordinary listener to miss a change. Use mutation- and reentrancy-safe dispatch with distinct subscription identities. Keep listener registrations independently removable and dispatch across stable indices. Added regressions for once, registration changes during dispatch, and duplicate callbacks.

title: flatMap ignores changes to the selected inner signal
note: Runtime updates were observed only when the outer selector changed. Track and dispose the active inner dependency on switches. Track the selected inner signal as a borrowed dependency and detach it when the outer selection changes or the result is disposed. Added reactive and lifecycle regressions.

title: A thrown history transaction disables undo recording
note: Subsequent writes leave history unchanged after a caught error. Implement exception-safe nesting and documented rollback or commit behavior. Finalize only the outer transaction and record changes already applied if the callback throws. Added tests for later recording and nested failure.

title: Hydration duplicates nodes in matching server HTML
note: Real server-to-client round trip duplicates a node after mixed element and text siblings. Use a single adoption protocol with serialized ranges. Serialize node order and insertion ownership for hydration, disable cloning while adopting, and use one cursor for legacy HTML. Verified mixed siblings, conditional branches, and keyed ranges against actual headless output.

title: Hydrated trees use divergent browser mutation APIs
note: Reactive data attributes stay stale and WithBrowserCtx can throw. Share the real browser context and isolate adoption logic. Use BrowserContext for all live bindings and specialize only node adoption during hydration. Added coverage for browser facilities, CSS custom properties, and data attributes.

title: SSR request factories leave subscriptions behind
note: Production APIs retained derivatives on a module signal across verified completed requests. One request session must own the factory, render, serialization and cleanup. Create the app inside each headless disposal scope and release that scope on success, render failure, or string serialization failure.

title: SSR stream ignores backpressure and disconnects
note: A slow-reader probe buffered 525963 bytes despite a 65536-byte high-water mark. Destroy-before-read skipped resource cleanup. Use a cancellation-aware pull pipeline. Drive SSR from a pull-based async iterable with bounded buffering, close the render scope on early cancellation, and avoid mounting after an asynchronous preparation was cancelled.

title: Documentation pre-renders loading placeholders in place of articles
note: All 13 generated article routes contained loading placeholders. Resolve route content before rendering and transfer the snapshot to the browser. Read each article before SSR and bootstrap the browser from its generated article markup. Verified all 14 docs pages and used Chromium to confirm the initial article is reused and later navigation fetches normally.

title: Vite islands mode generates no server or static render output
note: The documented islands path installs neither rendering plugin. Model generation and selective hydration as coordinated, separately testable choices. Register static generation and development SSR in islands mode independently of full hydration. Added build and dev integration tests and confirmed selective activation with Chromium.

title: Test task caches omit upstream package changes
note: Isolated edit to core did not change downstream UI test hashes. Declare upstream build inputs for test and coverage tasks. Make both test tasks depend on upstream builds and cache coverage reports as declared outputs. Verified the nested dependency graph and ran both tasks against the UI package.

title: Superseded queries and mutations still publish results
note: Both state machines unconditionally publish or clear the active controller. Commit only for the current operation and scope its cancellation/callbacks. Scope cancellation and publication to the current operation in both resources. Added deterministic regressions for stale success, stale rejection, disposal, and synchronous replacement.

title: SSG can publish partial output after build or route errors
note: Template and SSR prerequisites return on error, while route failures are logged and skipped. Stage and validate the complete output before publishing and fail the build on required errors. Reject missing build prerequisites and failed required routes. Stage every page and validate destinations before publishing them, with rollback for a failed replacement. Verified the Vite suite and the docs build.

title: Error boundary leaves partial children mounted
note: An earlier sibling survived fallback and teardown after a later child threw. Make rendering transactional for DOM and cleanup registrations.

title: Nested native fragments mount inside a hidden marker
note: MockBridge verified the parentage and Swift hides marker views. Insert nested markers under the actual host parent. Create nested reference markers before the enclosing marker in its actual parent, using the same insertion rules as native text and views.

title: Disposing an async mapping leaves its work running
note: Runtime signals stayed un-aborted and generator cleanup did not run. Tie operation and iterator ownership to disposal. Abort active operations and close async iterators when mapped signals are disposed. Release intermediate computation signals owned by async combinators.

title: Vite SSG and dev SSR disagree on the server entry contract
note: Default App export support differs and direct App rendering does not pass the request URL to the headless context. Share entry adaptation and route URL propagation.

title: Stored props can throw during initialization
note: Bad stored JSON or a quota failure during the eager default write can prevent construction. Guard access and decoding and define explicit persistence failures.

title: CI starts a second runner for the same coverage command
note: One extra job and workspace bootstrap per trigger. Use one authoritative coverage run and share its results.

title: Crawled SSG renders pages again when writing output
note: Current 32-path docs crawl takes 64 render calls. Emit each discovered render once while bounding in-flight work.

title: Docs build and deployment share privileges on PR-triggered runs
note: Effective rights depend on GitHub policy. Move deployment to a protected default-branch job and limit write permissions to that job.

title: SSR browser tests are skipped by workspace CI and cannot start cleanly
note: Express 5 rejects the wildcard registration. Repair the demo server and gate CI on actual SSR HTML followed by browser interactivity.

title: Hydration fixtures miss the server-to-client adoption contract
note: Single-tag fixture passes without using marker IDs. Round-trip real SSR output and assert identities, updates and cleanup.

title: sleep resolves with a pre-aborted signal and retains completed listeners
note: Check signal state before scheduling and remove the listener on every settled path. Reject already-aborted signals without scheduling a timer and unregister the abort listener on success or cancellation.

title: deepEqual treats absent Map keys as undefined entries
note: Independent Map membership with undefined fixture. Check key membership before comparing values. Check membership before comparing map values and verify symmetry for distinct keys with undefined values.

title: Documentation bootstrap ships every library body
note: Measured baseline 17820 bytes gzip versus 1619 for compact metadata. Fetch or render bodies per selected route.
